summary: Beeline Holdings, Inc. (BLNE) disclosed in an 8-K filed May 18, 2026 that its Board formed a special committee to explore strategic alternatives, including a potential related-party transaction with TTYL, a privately held blockchain-enabled platform for tokenizing fractional equity in U.S. residential real estate as real-world assets. No terms, price, or definitive agreement exists; the special committee comprises independent directors and can retain advisors. No decision has been made, and no timeline is provided. Watch for further announcements regarding the committee's progress or a definitive deal.
